zh: 成本只和每个字母的出现次数有关，与位置无关；某个字母出现 f 次时，再移除它一根，成本会下降 f²−(f−1)²=2f−1。
这个下降量随 f 增大而增大，所以每一步都应该从当前出现次数最多的字母上移除一根；若某一步移除了频次较低的字母，换成最高频字母不会让结果变差。
统计 26 个字母的频次，把非零频次放进最大堆；重复 min(M,N) 次：弹出最大频次 f，若 f>1 就把 f−1 放回堆中；最后把堆里所有频次的平方相加（用 64 位整数）输出。
en: The cost depends only on how many times each letter occurs, not on positions; when a letter occurs f times, removing one more of it lowers the cost by f^2 - (f-1)^2 = 2f - 1.

That drop grows with f, so every step should remove one candle of the letter that currently occurs most often; if some step removed a less frequent letter instead, switching to the most frequent one never makes the result worse.

Count the 26 letter frequencies and put the non-zero ones into a max-heap; repeat min(M, N) times: pop the largest frequency f and push f - 1 back if f > 1; finally print the sum of the squares of all frequencies left in the heap (in 64-bit integers).

explanationEn:
## Approach

Removing one candle of the character with the currently highest frequency gives the largest marginal gain each time; there are always 26 letter kinds, and the heap simulation runs at most min(M,N) times.

## Proof of correctness

Removing one more candle of a character with frequency f lowers the cost by f²−(f−1)²=2f−1. This marginal gain increases with f, so if some step removes a lower-frequency character instead of the current highest-frequency one, swapping that step's choice does not increase the cost. Repeating this greedy step simulates exactly the optimal sequence of at most M removals.

## Complexity

Time O(M log 26), space O(26).
